scenario: 面试要设计推荐/搜索的候选检索,你要先讲清 embedding 在系统里扮演什么角色。
scenario_en: Designing candidate retrieval for recs/search, you first explain what role embeddings play in the system.
q: embedding 是什么,在 ML 系统里主要支撑什么?
q_en: What is an embedding, and what does it mainly power in an ML system?
why: embedding 把原始内容(文本/图像/物品)编码成稠密向量,用向量相似度支撑候选检索和个性化(YouTube 推荐、Airbnb 搜索、电商匹配)。面试的深度不在选哪个模型,而在 embedding 怎么流经存储、索引、版本、重建——主动提运维问题(陈旧索引、重建)才是资深信号。
why_en: An embedding encodes raw content into a dense vector, powering candidate retrieval and personalization via vector similarity, and interview depth is about how it flows through storage, indexing, versioning, and rebuild.
diagram:
flowchart LR R["原始内容
文本/图像/物品"] --> E["embedding 模型"] E --> V["稠密向量"] V --> A["ANN 检索
候选生成/个性化"]
options: embedding 是一种数据库,专门存图片文件
embedding 是一种压缩算法,只为省存储空间
embedding 是模型的最后一层分类头,直接输出预测标签
embedding 把原始内容编码成稠密向量,用向量相似度支撑候选检索与个性化
options_en: An embedding is a kind of database specialized for storing image files.
An embedding is a compression algorithm whose only goal is saving storage.
An embedding is the model's final classification head that directly outputs a predicted label.
An embedding encodes raw content into a dense vector, powering candidate retrieval and personalization via vector similarity.
optionExplanations: embedding 不是数据库,它是内容的稠密向量表示,可以存进向量库但本身不是存储系统。
压缩是副作用不是目的,embedding 的核心价值是把语义放进可比较的向量空间。
分类头输出标签,embedding 输出的是可比相似度的向量表示,不是最终预测。
对;稠密向量+相似度检索是 embedding 的核心用途,面试深度在它的存储/索引/版本/重建生命周期。
optionExplanations_en: An embedding isn't a database; it's a dense vector representation of content that can be stored in a vector DB but isn't itself storage.
Compression is a side effect, not the goal; the core value is placing semantics into a comparable vector space.
A classification head outputs a label; an embedding outputs a comparable vector representation, not a final prediction.
Correct — dense vectors plus similarity retrieval are the core use, and interview depth lies in the storage/index/version/rebuild lifecycle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把原始内容(文本/图像/物品)映射成的稠密向量,语义相近的内容向量也相近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding maps raw content (text/image/item) into a dense vector where semantically similar content has nearby vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 维度不高但每维都有值的向量(如 128 维浮点),用向量相似度衡量语义接近程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dense vector has every dimension filled with a value (e.g. 128-dim floats), with similarity measuring semantic closeness.

scenario: 要给一个领域(如电商商品搜索)选 embedding:直接用公开预训练模型,还是在领域数据上训一个。
scenario_en: Choosing embeddings for a domain (e.g. e-commerce product search): use a public pre-trained model or train one on domain data.
q: 预训练 embedding vs 任务专用 embedding,区别是什么?
q_en: Pre-trained vs task-specific embeddings — what's the difference?
why: 预训练(Word2Vec/GloVe/通用 BERT)在公开语料上训好、开箱即用、无需领域训练;任务专用则在领域数据上微调或从头训(YouTube 检索的两塔、商品搜索的对比模型),更贴合领域语义但要训练成本。
why_en: Pre-trained (Word2Vec/GloVe/general BERT) is trained on public corpora and usable out of the box with no domain training, while task-specific is fine-tuned or trained from scratch on domain data for better fit at a training cost.
tradeoff: 预训练(开箱即用、无需领域训练、语义泛化) vs 任务专用(贴合领域、需训练成本)
options: 预训练在公开语料训好、开箱即用;任务专用在领域数据微调/从头训,更贴合领域但需训练成本
预训练更贵、任务专用免费,按价格划分
预训练只能用于文本、任务专用只能用于图像,按模态划分
两者完全一样,只是叫法不同
options_en: Pre-trained is trained on public corpora and usable out of the box; task-specific is fine-tuned/from scratch on domain data for better fit at a training cost.
Pre-trained is costlier and task-specific is free, split by price.
Pre-trained is text-only and task-specific is image-only, split by modality.
They're identical, just named differently.
optionExplanations: 对;区别在训练来源与领域贴合度:预训练通用开箱即用,任务专用用领域数据换更好的领域表现。
价格不是划分标准——预训练常免费开源,任务专用才要投入训练成本,选项说反了。
两类都可跨模态(有文本也有图像的预训练/任务专用模型),按模态划分不成立。
两者在领域贴合度和训练成本上有本质不同,不是同物异名。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the difference is training source and domain fit: pre-trained is general and out-of-box, task-specific spends domain data for better domain performance.
Price isn't the criterion — pre-trained is often free/open, task-specific incurs training cost, so the option is backwards.
Both span modalities (there are text and image pre-trained/task-specific models), so a modality split fails.
They differ fundamentally in domain fit and training cost, not just naming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在通用公开语料上训好的 embedding 模型(Word2Vec/GloVe/通用 BERT),开箱即用无需领域训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pre-trained embedding model is trained on general public corpora (Word2Vec/GloVe/general BERT), usable out of the box without domain training.

termDefinitions.term: task-specific embedding / 任务专用嵌入
termDefinitions.meaning: 在领域数据上微调或从头训练的 embedding(两塔、对比学习),更贴合特定任务语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A task-specific embedding is fine-tuned or trained from scratch on domain data (two-tower, contrastive) to fit the task's semantics.

scenario: 两种场景:(A)通用文本语义已够用、想快速上线;(B)检索质量直接影响营收、值得投入训练。
scenario_en: Two settings: (A) general text semantics suffice and you want a fast launch; (B) retrieval quality directly drives revenue, worth training investment.
q: 什么时候选预训练、什么时候选任务专用 embedding?
q_en: When do you pick pre-trained vs task-specific embeddings?
why: 看领域贴合的边际收益 vs 训练成本:通用语义够用、要快上线时用预训练;当领域语义差异大、检索质量直接换营收时,任务专用的更好表现值回训练与重建成本。
why_en: Weigh the marginal gain of domain fit against training cost: use pre-trained when general semantics suffice and speed matters, task-specific when domain gaps are large and retrieval quality converts to revenue.
tradeoff: 预训练(快、省、通用够用时) vs 任务专用(准、贵、领域差异大且质量换营收时)
options: 永远选任务专用,自己训的一定比公开的好
随机选一个,反正 embedding 都差不多
永远选预训练,省事就行,领域差异不重要
看领域贴合边际收益 vs 训练成本:通用够用/要快就预训练,领域差异大且质量换营收就任务专用
options_en: Always pick task-specific; self-trained always beats public.
Pick randomly; embeddings are all about the same.
Always pick pre-trained; convenience wins and domain differences don't matter.
Weigh domain-fit gain vs training cost: pre-trained when general suffices/speed matters, task-specific when domain gaps are large and quality converts to revenue.
whenOtherWins: 如果领域文本与通用语料差异极小(如标准英语描述),预训练已经足够,硬训任务专用只是白烧训练与重建成本。
whenOtherWins_en: If the domain text barely differs from general corpora (standard English descriptions), pre-trained already suffices and training a task-specific model just burns cost.
optionExplanations: 「永远任务专用」忽略了训练+重建成本,通用语义够用时它并不划算。
embedding 之间差异很大(上下文、模态、领域贴合),随机选是不负责任的。
「永远预训练」在领域语义差异大时会牺牲检索质量,进而丢营收,不能一概而论。
对;决策看领域贴合的边际收益能否盖过训练/重建成本,而非一刀切。
optionExplanations_en: 'Always task-specific' ignores training+rebuild cost and isn't worth it when general semantics suffice.
Embeddings differ a lot (context, modality, domain fit), so picking randomly is irresponsible.
'Always pre-trained' sacrifices retrieval quality when domain gaps are large, losing revenue, so it can't be blanket.
Correct — the decision weighs whether domain-fit gain exceeds training/rebuild cost, not a blanket rule.

termDefinitions.meaning: embedding 对特定领域语义的适配程度;领域差异越大,任务专用的边际收益越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain fit is how well an embedding matches a domain's semantics; larger domain gaps raise the marginal gain of task-specific.

scenario: 「bank」在「river bank」和「bank account」里意思完全不同,你在评估某个 embedding 模型能否区分。
scenario_en: 'bank' means different things in 'river bank' vs 'bank account'; you assess whether a given embedding model can tell them apart.
q: Word2Vec 的核心特性和局限是什么?
q_en: What's Word2Vec's core characteristic and limitation?
why: Word2Vec 给静态的词级向量,快但无上下文:不管在什么句子里,「bank」永远是同一个向量,分不清河岸和银行。适合当轻量特征输入,不适合需要上下文消歧的语义任务。
why_en: Word2Vec gives static word-level vectors — fast but context-free, so 'bank' has the same vector regardless of sentence, unable to disambiguate river bank from bank account.
options: Word2Vec 给静态词级向量,快但无上下文,bank 永远同一个向量分不清词义
Word2Vec 给上下文相关的词向量,能区分 bank 的两种含义
Word2Vec 是多模态模型,能同时编码文本和图像
Word2Vec 推理成本极高,不适合实时使用
options_en: Word2Vec gives static word-level vectors — fast but context-free, so bank is always the same vector, unable to disambiguate.
Word2Vec gives context-dependent word vectors and can tell the two senses of bank apart.
Word2Vec is a multimodal model that encodes text and images together.
Word2Vec has extremely high inference cost, unsuitable for real-time use.
optionExplanations: 对;静态、词级、快是它的特点,无上下文是它的核心局限,bank 只有一个向量。
Word2Vec 恰恰不含上下文,同一个词只有一个静态向量,无法区分词义。
Word2Vec 是纯文本词级模型,不是多模态,编不了图像。
Word2Vec 极轻量、推理很快,「成本极高」说反了,它正因快而适合当特征输入。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — static, word-level, and fast are its traits, and context-free is its core limit, so bank has one vector.
Word2Vec is exactly context-free; one word has a single static vector and can't disambiguate senses.
Word2Vec is a text-only word-level model, not multimodal, and can't encode images.
Word2Vec is very lightweight and fast; 'extremely high cost' is backwards — its speed suits it as a feature input.

termDefinitions.meaning: 静态词级 embedding 模型,快但无上下文,同一词恒为同一向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Word2Vec is a static word-level embedding model, fast but context-free, giving one vector per word regardless of sentence.

termDefinitions.term: static vs contextual / 静态 vs 上下文
termDefinitions.meaning: 静态嵌入词义固定不随句子变,上下文嵌入同词随语境给不同向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Static embeddings fix a word's vector, while contextual embeddings give different vectors for the same word by context.

scenario: 要给一个上千万文档的大语料做实时编码检索,你在权衡 BERT 这类上下文模型的成本。
scenario_en: Encoding a corpus of tens of millions of docs in real time, you weigh the cost of contextual models like BERT.
q: BERT 类 embedding 的优势和主要代价是什么?
q_en: What's the strength and main cost of BERT-style embeddings?
why: BERT 靠全序列注意力给上下文相关的 token 级向量,语义更丰富(能区分 bank 词义);但推理成本高,对大语料做实时编码很贵。丰富语义 vs 推理开销是它的核心取舍。
why_en: BERT gives contextual token-level vectors via full-sequence attention, richer semantics but high inference cost, making real-time encoding of a large corpus expensive.
tradeoff: BERT(上下文语义丰富) vs 高推理成本(大语料实时编码很贵)
options: BERT 无上下文、速度极快,但语义太浅
BERT 只能编码单个词,不能处理句子
BERT 靠全序列注意力给上下文 token 向量,语义丰富但推理成本高,大语料实时编码贵
BERT 推理几乎零成本,可以无限量实时编码
options_en: BERT is context-free and extremely fast, but semantically shallow.
BERT can only encode single words, not sentences.
BERT gives contextual token vectors via full-sequence attention — rich semantics but high inference cost, expensive to encode large corpora in real time.
BERT inference is near-zero cost, allowing unlimited real-time encoding.
optionExplanations: BERT 恰恰有上下文且较重,「无上下文、极快」描述的是 Word2Vec 不是 BERT。
BERT 处理整个序列、给 token 级向量,能编码句子而非只编单词。
对;全序列注意力带来上下文语义,代价是高推理成本,大语料实时编码尤其贵。
BERT 推理成本高,「几乎零成本无限量」与它的重计算特性相悖。
optionExplanations_en: BERT is precisely contextual and heavy; 'context-free, extremely fast' describes Word2Vec, not BERT.
BERT processes the whole sequence and gives token-level vectors, encoding sentences, not just single words.
Correct — full-sequence attention yields contextual semantics at the cost of high inference, especially expensive for real-time large-corpus encoding.
BERT inference is costly; 'near-zero, unlimited' contradicts its heavy compute.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于全序列注意力的上下文 token 级 embedding 模型,语义丰富但推理成本高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BERT is a contextual token-level embedding model using full-sequence attention, rich in semantics but costly to infer.

termDefinitions.term: full-sequence attention / 全序列注意力
termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 token 都与序列里所有 token 交互算注意力,带来上下文但计算量大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Full-sequence attention has each token attend to all others in the sequence, giving context at high compute cost.

scenario: 产品需求:用户输入一段文字 query,要检索出相关的图像(文搜图)。
scenario_en: Product need: a user types a text query and retrieves relevant images (text-to-image search).
q: CLIP 有什么独特能力,靠什么实现?
q_en: What unique capability does CLIP have, and how?
why: CLIP 靠对比预训练把文本和图像对齐到同一个共享向量空间,从而支持跨模态检索:文字 query 的向量能直接和图像向量比相似度,实现文搜图。这是单模态模型做不到的。
why_en: CLIP uses contrastive pre-training to align text and image into a shared vector space, enabling cross-modal retrieval so a text query's vector can be compared directly with image vectors.
options: CLIP 只处理图像,靠卷积网络分类物体
CLIP 只能编码文本,和 BERT 用途完全一样
CLIP 是更快的 Word2Vec,只是词向量维度更高
CLIP 靠对比预训练把文本和图像对齐到共享空间,支持跨模态检索(文搜图)
options_en: CLIP handles only images, classifying objects via a convolutional network.
CLIP encodes only text and is functionally identical to BERT.
CLIP is a faster Word2Vec, just with higher-dimensional word vectors.
CLIP uses contrastive pre-training to align text and image into a shared space, enabling cross-modal retrieval (text-to-image).
optionExplanations: CLIP 不是单纯图像分类器,它的关键是把文本和图像放进同一空间做跨模态匹配。
CLIP 同时编码文本和图像,与只做文本的 BERT 用途不同。
CLIP 与 Word2Vec 无关,它是多模态对比模型不是更快的词向量。
对;对比预训练对齐文图共享空间,是 CLIP 支持文搜图这类跨模态检索的根本。
optionExplanations_en: CLIP isn't a plain image classifier; its key is placing text and image in one space for cross-modal matching.
CLIP encodes both text and images, differing from text-only BERT.
CLIP is unrelated to Word2Vec; it's a multimodal contrastive model, not a faster word vector.
Correct — contrastive pre-training aligning a shared text-image space is what lets CLIP do cross-modal retrieval like text-to-image.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对比预训练把文本与图像对齐到共享向量空间的模型,支持跨模态检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) aligns text and image into a shared vector space via contrastive learning, enabling cross-modal retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一种模态的 query(文字)检索另一种模态的结果(图像),需共享向量空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cross-modal retrieval uses a query in one modality (text) to retrieve results in another (image), requiring a shared vector space.

scenario: 要做语义搜索:给一段自然语言 query,检索语义相近的句子/文档,还要兼顾质量和速度。
scenario_en: Building semantic search: given a natural-language query, retrieve semantically similar sentences/docs while balancing quality and speed.
q: 语义搜索的当前默认 embedding 选择是什么,为什么?
q_en: What's the current default embedding for semantic search, and why?
why: Sentence Transformers(孪生/Siamese BERT)给句子级向量,是语义搜索的当前默认——它在质量和速度间取得平衡:比原始 BERT 更适合直接比句子相似度,又不像逐 token 那么慢。
why_en: Sentence Transformers (Siamese BERT) give sentence-level vectors and are the current default for semantic search, balancing quality and speed better than raw BERT for comparing sentence similarity.
tradeoff: Sentence Transformers(句级、质量/速度平衡) vs 原始BERT(token级、直接比句子慢)
options: Word2Vec,因为它最快,句子语义无所谓
原始 BERT 逐 token 编码,直接拿 token 向量比句子相似度
Sentence Transformers(孪生BERT)给句子级向量,质量/速度平衡,是语义搜索默认
CLIP,因为语义搜索本质是跨模态问题
options_en: Word2Vec, because it's fastest and sentence semantics don't matter.
Raw BERT token-by-token, comparing token vectors for sentence similarity directly.
Sentence Transformers (Siamese BERT) give sentence-level vectors, balancing quality and speed — the semantic-search default.
CLIP, because semantic search is fundamentally a cross-modal problem.
whenOtherWins: 如果 query 是跨模态的(文字搜图像),就该用 CLIP 而非 Sentence Transformers;后者是同模态句子语义搜索的默认。
whenOtherWins_en: If the query is cross-modal (text-to-image), use CLIP rather than Sentence Transformers, which is the default for same-modality sentence-semantic search.
optionExplanations: Word2Vec 无上下文、无句子级语义,做语义搜索质量太差,速度快救不了它。
原始 BERT 直接比 token 向量做句子相似度既慢又不最优,Sentence Transformers 正是为此改良。
对;句子级向量+质量速度平衡使它成为语义搜索默认,直接比句子相似度效果好。
语义搜索通常是同模态文本任务,CLIP 是跨模态的,用在纯文本搜索上是杀鸡用牛刀且不最优。
optionExplanations_en: Word2Vec is context-free with no sentence-level semantics, too weak for semantic search, and speed can't save it.
Raw BERT comparing token vectors for sentence similarity is slow and suboptimal, which Sentence Transformers were built to fix.
Correct — sentence-level vectors plus a quality/speed balance make it the semantic-search default, effective for comparing sentence similarity.
Semantic search is usually same-modality text; CLIP is cross-modal, overkill and suboptimal for pure-text search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 孪生(Siamese)BERT 结构,直接产出句子级 embedding,语义搜索的当前默认。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sentence Transformers are a Siamese BERT architecture producing sentence-level embeddings, the current default for semantic search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个共享权重的编码塔分别编码两段输入,便于直接比它们的向量相似度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Siamese network uses two weight-sharing towers to encode two inputs so their vector similarity is directly comparable.

scenario: 要在 Word2Vec / BERT / CLIP / Sentence Transformers 里按上下文能力、模态、推理成本做横向对比。
scenario_en: Comparing Word2Vec / BERT / CLIP / Sentence Transformers on context, modality, and inference cost.
q: 四类 embedding 模型的关键区分维度是什么?
q_en: What are the key distinguishing dimensions across the four embedding models?
why: 关键维:粒度/上下文/模态/推理成本。Word2Vec 词级静态、成本低;BERT token 级上下文、成本高;CLIP 多模态、成本中;Sentence Transformers 句级上下文、成本中、语义搜索默认。选型按任务粒度和成本预算定。
why_en: Key axes: granularity, context, modality, inference cost — Word2Vec is word-level static and cheap, BERT is token-level contextual and costly, CLIP is multimodal and medium, Sentence Transformers is sentence-level and the semantic-search default.
options: 粒度/上下文/模态/推理成本:词级静态低成本→token上下文高成本→多模态中→句级默认
只有推理速度一个维度,越快越好其它不重要
只有模型大小一个维度,越大越好
四者完全等价,随便选一个都行
options_en: Granularity/context/modality/inference cost: word-static-cheap → token-contextual-costly → multimodal-medium → sentence-default.
Only inference speed matters; faster is better and nothing else counts.
Only model size matters; bigger is better.
The four are equivalent; pick any.
optionExplanations: 对;粒度、上下文、模态、成本四维把四个模型分开,选型据任务与预算而定。
只看速度会忽略上下文能力和模态——语义搜索需要上下文,Word2Vec 再快也不够。
只看大小忽略了模态和上下文匹配,大模型未必适合跨模态或轻量场景。
四者在上下文、模态、成本上系统性不同,随便选会用错工具。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — granularity, context, modality, and cost separate the four; choose by task and budget.
Speed-only ignores context and modality — semantic search needs context, and fast Word2Vec still falls short.
Size-only ignores modality and context match; a big model may not fit cross-modal or lightweight needs.
The four differ systematically in context, modality, and cost, so picking any uses the wrong tool.

termDefinitions.meaning: 与 Word2Vec 类似的静态词向量模型,基于全局共现统计训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GloVe (Global Vectors) is a static word-vector model like Word2Vec, trained on global co-occurrence statistics.

scenario: 拿到一个预训练 embedding 模型上生产,要决定是冻结权重直接用,还是在领域数据上微调。
scenario_en: Taking a pre-trained embedding model to production, you decide whether to freeze weights or fine-tune on domain data.
q: 冻结(freeze) vs 微调(fine-tune) embedding 模型,核心区别是什么?
q_en: Freeze vs fine-tune an embedding model — what's the core difference?
why: 冻结=权重固定:更便宜、避免灾难性遗忘、且因模型不变不需要重建索引;微调=适配领域语义、任务表现更好,但要重训基础设施、embedding 版本管理,并触发全量重编码 + ANN 索引重建。关键把 freeze/fine-tune 连到索引管理影响,而不只看精度。
why_en: Freeze fixes weights — cheaper, avoids catastrophic forgetting, and needs no index rebuild since the model doesn't change, while fine-tune adapts to domain semantics but triggers full re-encoding and an ANN index rebuild.
tradeoff: 冻结(便宜、无需重建索引) vs 微调(领域表现好、触发全量重编码+索引重建)
options: 冻结=权重固定、便宜、无需重建索引;微调=领域适配更好但触发全量重编码+ANN索引重建
冻结和微调都要重建索引,区别只在训练时长
微调更便宜因为不用重编码,冻结更贵因为要重训
两者对下游索引没有任何影响,只影响精度
options_en: Freeze = fixed weights, cheaper, no index rebuild; fine-tune = better domain fit but triggers full re-encoding + ANN index rebuild.
Both freeze and fine-tune require an index rebuild; the only difference is training time.
Fine-tune is cheaper because it skips re-encoding; freeze is costlier because it retrains.
Neither affects the downstream index; they only affect accuracy.
optionExplanations: 对;冻结不改模型故无需重建索引,微调改了向量空间就要全量重编码+索引重建,这才是关键运维影响。
冻结不改模型、无需重建索引,「都要重建」把冻结的关键优势抹掉了。
说反了:微调才要重编码+重建更贵,冻结不训练不重建更便宜。
微调恰恰重塑向量空间、必须重建索引,「对索引无影响」忽略了核心运维代价。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — freeze doesn't change the model so needs no rebuild, while fine-tune shifts the vector space and forces full re-encoding + rebuild, the key ops impact.
Freeze doesn't change the model and needs no rebuild; 'both rebuild' erases freeze's key advantage.
Backwards: fine-tune is the costlier one needing re-encoding+rebuild, while freeze neither trains nor rebuilds.
Fine-tune precisely reshapes the vector space and must rebuild the index; 'no index impact' ignores the core ops cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保持预训练权重不变直接用,便宜且不改向量空间,故不触发索引重建。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freeze keeps pre-trained weights fixed, cheap and unchanging to the vector space, so it triggers no index rebuild.

termDefinitions.meaning: 微调时模型在新数据上覆盖掉原先学到的通用知识,冻结可避免这一风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Catastrophic forgetting is fine-tuning overwriting previously learned general knowledge; freezing avoids this risk.

scenario: 团队决定季度性微调 embedding 模型,你要向面试官讲清这在运维上会连锁触发什么。
scenario_en: The team fine-tunes the embedding model quarterly, and you must explain the operational chain this triggers.
q: 微调 embedding 模型会连锁触发哪些运维动作?
q_en: What operational chain does fine-tuning an embedding model trigger?
why: 微调改变了向量空间,旧向量作废:必须用新模型全量重新编码整个语料 → 重建 ANN 索引 → 还要做 embedding 版本管理(保留新旧版本供切换)。资深回答会把微调直接连到「重编码+重建+版本管理」这条运维链,而不止说「精度更高」。
why_en: Fine-tuning shifts the vector space and invalidates old vectors, so you must re-encode the whole corpus with the new model, rebuild the ANN index, and manage embedding versions.
options: 什么都不用做,微调后旧索引照常能用
只需把新模型部署上线,索引会自动跟着更新
全量重新编码语料→重建 ANN 索引→embedding 版本管理(留新旧供切换)
只需清空索引,不用重编码
options_en: Nothing — after fine-tuning the old index still works fine.
Just deploy the new model; the index auto-updates with it.
Re-encode the whole corpus → rebuild the ANN index → manage embedding versions (keep old+new for switching).
Just clear the index; no re-encoding needed.
optionExplanations: 微调后向量空间变了,旧索引里的旧向量和新模型不兼容,「照常能用」会导致静默退化。
索引不会自动更新,新模型的向量要显式全量重编码并重建索引才生效。
对;重编码+重建索引+版本管理是微调的必然连锁,这条运维链正是资深信号。
清空不重编码等于没有可检索的向量,重编码是必须的一步不能省。
optionExplanations_en: Fine-tuning shifts the vector space, so old index vectors are incompatible with the new model; 'still works' causes silent degradation.
The index doesn't auto-update; the new model's vectors need explicit full re-encoding and a rebuild to take effect.
Correct — re-encoding + rebuild + version management is the inevitable chain of fine-tuning, and naming it is the senior signal.
Clearing without re-encoding leaves no vectors to search; re-encoding is a mandatory step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用新的 embedding 模型把整个语料重新计算成新向量,微调后必须做。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Re-encoding recomputes the entire corpus into new vectors with the new embedding model, mandatory after fine-tuning.

termDefinitions.term: embedding versioning / 嵌入版本管理
termDefinitions.meaning: 同时保留每个实体的新旧向量版本,让服务在切换期路由到正确版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding versioning keeps old and new vectors per entity so serving routes to the right version during transitions.

scenario: 金融风控:在交易描述文本上做欺诈相关的语义理解,通用语义已经够用,且不想承担重建索引的运维负担。
scenario_en: Fintech risk: semantic understanding of transaction-description text where general semantics suffice and you'd rather avoid index-rebuild ops.
q: 金融风控对交易描述用 BERT,该冻结还是微调?
q_en: For fintech fraud on transaction descriptions, should you freeze or fine-tune BERT?
why: 冻结。交易描述的通用语义 BERT 已经够用,冻结省下重训与索引重建的成本、也避免灾难性遗忘。没有足够强的领域收益去抵消微调的重建代价时,冻结是更划算的选择。
why_en: Freeze — general BERT semantics already suffice for transaction descriptions, so freezing saves retraining and index-rebuild cost and avoids catastrophic forgetting.
tradeoff: 冻结(通用语义够、省重建) vs 微调(领域收益不足以抵消重建代价)
options: 微调,任何场景微调都更准,重建成本不重要
每天微调一次,保持模型最新
既不冻结也不微调,直接不用 embedding
冻结:通用语义够用,省下重训+索引重建成本、避免灾难性遗忘
options_en: Fine-tune — it's always more accurate and rebuild cost doesn't matter.
Fine-tune daily to keep the model current.
Neither freeze nor fine-tune; just drop embeddings entirely.
Freeze: general semantics suffice, saving retraining + index-rebuild cost and avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
whenOtherWins: 如果交易描述含大量领域黑话/行业缩写,通用 BERT 分不清,那微调的领域收益就可能盖过重建成本,值得微调。
whenOtherWins_en: If transaction descriptions are full of domain jargon general BERT can't parse, fine-tuning's domain gain may outweigh rebuild cost and become worthwhile.
optionExplanations: 微调不是无条件更好——通用语义够用时,它的重建成本没有对应领域收益,得不偿失。
每天微调=每天全量重编码+重建索引,运维代价极高且无必要。
不用 embedding 就做不了语义检索,这是回避问题不是选择。
对;通用够用+想省重建时冻结最划算,还顺带避免灾难性遗忘。
optionExplanations_en: Fine-tune isn't unconditionally better — when general semantics suffice, its rebuild cost has no matching domain gain, a net loss.
Daily fine-tuning means daily full re-encoding + rebuild, extremely costly and unnecessary.
Dropping embeddings makes semantic retrieval impossible; that's evasion, not a choice.
Correct — with general semantics sufficient and rebuild to avoid, freeze is most economical and dodges catastrophic forgetting.

termDefinitions.term: index-management impact / 索引管理影响
termDefinitions.meaning: 模型是否变会决定要不要重编码与重建索引,是 freeze/fine-tune 决策的关键代价维。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Index-management impact is whether a model change forces re-encoding and rebuild, a key cost dimension of the freeze/fine-tune decision.

scenario: 电商搜索:检索质量直接影响转化和营收,领域词汇(品牌/品类/属性)与通用语义差异大。
scenario_en: E-commerce search: retrieval quality directly drives conversion and revenue, with domain vocabulary (brands/categories/attributes) far from general semantics.
q: 电商搜索该冻结还是季度微调 Sentence Transformers,为什么?
q_en: Should e-commerce search freeze or fine-tune Sentence Transformers quarterly, and why?
why: 季度微调。检索质量直接换营收,领域语义差异大,微调带来的检索提升值回全量重编码+索引重建的成本。这里领域收益盖过了重建代价,和金融风控冻结正好相反。
why_en: Fine-tune quarterly — retrieval quality converts to revenue and domain gaps are large, so the retrieval gains justify the full re-encoding and index-rebuild cost.
tradeoff: 季度微调(领域检索提升换营收、接受重建) vs 冻结(省成本但领域检索质量受限)
options: 冻结,微调太麻烦,检索差点无所谓
季度微调:检索质量直接换营收、领域差异大,提升值回重编码+重建成本
每小时微调一次,越频繁越好
完全不用 embedding,改用关键词精确匹配
options_en: Freeze — fine-tuning is a hassle and slightly worse retrieval is fine.
Fine-tune quarterly: retrieval quality converts to revenue and domain gaps are large, so gains justify re-encoding + rebuild cost.
Fine-tune hourly — the more often the better.
Drop embeddings entirely and use exact keyword matching.
whenOtherWins: 如果检索质量对营收边际影响很小,或重建成本极高(超大语料 + 紧预算),那冻结反而更划算,不必季度微调。
whenOtherWins_en: If retrieval quality barely moves revenue, or rebuild cost is prohibitive (huge corpus + tight budget), freezing is more economical and quarterly fine-tuning isn't worth it.
optionExplanations: 检索差直接掉转化掉营收,「无所谓」在电商里代价很大,冻结在此不划算。
对;领域差异大且质量换营收,季度微调的检索收益盖过重建成本,是合理取舍。
每小时微调=每小时重编码全量语料+重建索引,成本爆炸且收益边际递减,过度频繁。
关键词精确匹配丢掉语义泛化,搜不到同义/近义表达,检索质量反而更差。
optionExplanations_en: Poor retrieval directly cuts conversion and revenue; 'fine' is costly in e-commerce, so freezing isn't economical here.
Correct — large domain gaps and quality-to-revenue make quarterly fine-tuning's gains exceed rebuild cost, a sound tradeoff.
Hourly fine-tuning means hourly full re-encoding + rebuild, exploding cost with diminishing returns, far too frequent.
Exact keyword matching loses semantic generalization, missing synonyms/paraphrases and worsening retrieval quality.

termDefinitions.term: retrieval quality to revenue / 检索质量换营收
termDefinitions.meaning: 在电商/搜索里,更好的检索直接提升点击、转化与营收,故值得投入微调与重建。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In e-commerce/search, better retrieval directly lifts clicks, conversion, and revenue, justifying fine-tuning and rebuild investment.

scenario: 目录有 1 亿(100M)个物品,serving 时要为每个 query 找最相似的若干个物品向量。
scenario_en: The catalog has 100M items and at serving time you must find the most similar item vectors for each query.
q: 为什么 1 亿量级要用近似最近邻(ANN)而不是暴力精确检索?
q_en: Why use approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) instead of brute-force exact search at 100M scale?
why: 暴力检索要把 query 和每一个物品向量逐个算余弦相似度,1 亿次比对在 serving 延迟内根本跑不完。ANN 用索引结构把搜索降到次线性,牺牲一点召回换到亚毫秒级延迟,是海量向量检索的唯一可行解。
why_en: Brute-force cosine against every one of 100M item vectors can't finish within serving latency, so ANN uses an index structure to make search sublinear, trading a little recall for sub-millisecond latency.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Q["query 向量"] --> B{"1亿物品?"}
  B -->|暴力: 1亿次比对| X["超延迟预算✗"]
  B -->|ANN: 次线性| Y["亚毫秒✓ 略损召回"]
options: 暴力检索在 1 亿量级也很快,用 ANN 只是习惯
ANN 只是省内存,和延迟无关
ANN 比暴力更精确,所以永远该用 ANN
暴力检索要 1 亿次逐个比相似度、超延迟预算;ANN 把搜索降到次线性,略损召回换亚毫秒延迟
options_en: Brute-force is fast even at 100M; ANN is just habit.
ANN only saves memory and is unrelated to latency.
ANN is more accurate than brute-force, so always use ANN.
Brute-force needs 100M pairwise comparisons and blows the latency budget; ANN makes search sublinear, trading a little recall for sub-ms latency.
optionExplanations: 1 亿次逐个余弦相似度在 serving 延迟内跑不完,「也很快」与规模事实相悖。
ANN 主要解决的是延迟(次线性搜索),省内存是部分索引家族的附带特性。
ANN 是「近似」,精度略低于暴力精确检索,「更精确」说反了。
对;暴力线性于目录大小、扛不住 1 亿,ANN 次线性搜索用略损召回换到可用延迟。
optionExplanations_en: 100M pairwise cosine can't finish within serving latency, so 'also fast' contradicts the scale reality.
ANN mainly solves latency (sublinear search); memory saving is an incidental trait of some index families.
ANN is 'approximate' with slightly lower accuracy than exact brute-force, so 'more accurate' is backwards.
Correct — brute-force is linear in catalog size and can't handle 100M, while ANN's sublinear search buys usable latency for slight recall loss.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用索引结构在海量向量里近似地找最相似向量,牺牲少量召回换大幅提速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) uses an index to approximately find the most similar vectors, trading slight recall for large speedups.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用两向量夹角余弦衡量语义相近程度,值越大越相似。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cosine similarity measures semantic closeness by the cosine of the angle between two vectors; higher means more similar.

scenario: 选 ANN 索引:有基于树的 Annoy、基于图的 HNSW、基于量化的 IVF-PQ(FAISS),要按召回/延迟/内存权衡。
scenario_en: Choosing an ANN index: tree-based Annoy, graph-based HNSW, quantization-based IVF-PQ (FAISS), weighing recall/latency/memory.
q: 三大 ANN 索引家族各自的特点是什么?
q_en: What characterizes the three ANN index families?
why: 树基(Annoy,随机投影树):简单,但高维下表现差;图基(HNSW):召回/延迟最佳,现代向量库(Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector)最常用;量化基(FAISS 的 IVF-PQ,Voronoi 分区+压缩向量):内存高效,适合超大语料。按召回、延迟、内存三者权衡选型。
why_en: Tree-based (Annoy, random-projection trees) is simple but weak in high dimensions, graph-based (HNSW) has the best recall/latency and dominates modern vector DBs, and quantization-based (FAISS IVF-PQ) compresses vectors for memory efficiency on very large corpora.
options: 三者完全一样,只是名字不同
树基(Annoy)简单但高维差;图基(HNSW)召回/延迟最佳最常用;量化基(IVF-PQ)内存高效适合超大语料
树基召回最高、图基最省内存、量化基最简单
只有 HNSW 能用,其它两个已淘汰
options_en: The three are identical, just named differently.
Tree-based (Annoy) is simple but weak in high-dim; graph-based (HNSW) has best recall/latency, most common; quantization-based (IVF-PQ) is memory-efficient for huge corpora.
Tree-based has the highest recall, graph-based saves the most memory, quantization-based is the simplest.
Only HNSW is usable; the other two are obsolete.
optionExplanations: 三者在召回、延迟、内存上取舍不同,不是同物异名。
对;树简单但高维弱、图召回延迟最佳最主流、量化省内存扛超大语料,是标准三分。
属性张冠李戴:图基才是召回/延迟最佳,量化基才最省内存,树基才最简单。
Annoy/IVF-PQ 各有适用场景(高维小库、超大内存受限),并未淘汰。
optionExplanations_en: The three trade off differently on recall, latency, and memory; not the same thing renamed.
Correct — tree simple but weak in high-dim, graph best recall/latency and mainstream, quantization memory-efficient for huge corpora, the standard split.
Attributes mismatched: graph-based has best recall/latency, quantization-based saves most memory, tree-based is simplest.
Annoy/IVF-PQ each have niches (small high-dim, huge memory-bound), and aren't obsolete.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于图的 ANN 索引,召回/延迟表现最佳,Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector 等现代向量库主流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a graph-based ANN index with the best recall/latency, mainstream in modern vector DBs.

termDefinitions.meaning: FAISS 里的量化索引,用 Voronoi 分区+向量压缩,内存高效,适合超大语料。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF-PQ (Inverted File with Product Quantization) in FAISS uses Voronoi partitioning plus vector compression, memory-efficient for very large corpora.

termDefinitions.meaning: Spotify 开源的树基(随机投影树)ANN 索引,简单但在高维空间表现较弱。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Annoy is Spotify's tree-based (random-projection tree) ANN index, simple but weaker in high dimensions.

scenario: ANN 索引可调:搜索更多邻居/分区能提召回,但也拉高延迟。要在质量和速度间定档位。
scenario_en: An ANN index is tunable: searching more neighbors/partitions raises recall but also latency, and you set the quality-speed dial.
q: ANN 检索的核心可调旋钮是什么,怎么权衡?
q_en: What's the core tunable knob in ANN retrieval, and how do you trade it off?
why: 核心旋钮是召回 vs 延迟:搜索的邻居/分区越多,召回越高但延迟越高;越少则越快但漏得越多。按产品的延迟 SLA 和质量要求定档——比如要 sub-10ms 就把搜索范围压到刚好还能保住目标召回。
why_en: The core knob is recall vs latency: searching more neighbors/partitions raises recall but latency, while fewer is faster but misses more, so tune to the product's latency SLA and quality target.
tradeoff: 搜更多邻居/分区(召回高、延迟高) vs 搜更少(快、漏得多)
options: 核心旋钮是向量维度,维度越高召回一定越好
核心旋钮是模型大小,模型越大检索越快
核心旋钮是召回 vs 延迟:搜更多邻居/分区召回高但延迟高,按延迟SLA和质量要求定档
ANN 没有可调旋钮,召回和延迟是固定的
options_en: The core knob is vector dimension; higher dimension always means better recall.
The core knob is model size; a bigger model retrieves faster.
The core knob is recall vs latency: searching more neighbors/partitions raises recall but latency; tune to the latency SLA and quality target.
ANN has no tunable knob; recall and latency are fixed.
whenOtherWins: 如果场景对召回极其敏感(如安全/合规检索,漏一个都不行),就该往召回侧调、接受更高延迟,甚至退回精确检索。
whenOtherWins_en: If the use case is extremely recall-sensitive (safety/compliance retrieval where missing one is unacceptable), tune toward recall and accept higher latency, even reverting to exact search.
optionExplanations: 维度不是 ANN 的检索旋钮,且高维反而给树基索引带来困难,「一定更好」不成立。
模型大小影响编码不影响 ANN 检索速度,「越大越快」无关且错误。
对;召回/延迟是 ANN 的核心权衡旋钮,搜索范围决定二者,按 SLA 定档。
ANN 恰恰通过搜索范围(邻居/分区数)可调,召回延迟不是固定的。
optionExplanations_en: Dimension isn't ANN's retrieval knob, and high dimensions actually hurt tree-based indexes, so 'always better' fails.
Model size affects encoding, not ANN retrieval speed; 'bigger is faster' is irrelevant and wrong.
Correct — recall/latency is ANN's core trade knob, set by search breadth and tuned to the SLA.
ANN is precisely tunable via search breadth (neighbors/partitions), so recall/latency isn't fixed.

termDefinitions.term: recall vs latency knob / 召回-延迟旋钮
termDefinitions.meaning: ANN 中搜索的邻居/分区数量:搜得越多召回越高但越慢,是核心可调权衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The recall-vs-latency knob is how many neighbors/partitions ANN searches: more means higher recall but slower, the core tunable trade-off.

scenario: Spotify/Pinterest 用调好的 HNSW/FAISS 在生产里做到 >95% 召回 + sub-10ms p99 延迟。
scenario_en: Spotify/Pinterest hit >95% recall at sub-10ms p99 latency in production with tuned HNSW/FAISS.
q: 「>95% 召回 + sub-10ms p99」这组数字说明什么?
q_en: What does '>95% recall at sub-10ms p99' demonstrate?
why: >95% 召回和 sub-10ms p99 是行业里调优后可达的经验标杆(不是理论上限):它说明用 HNSW/FAISS 调好后,近似检索能同时拿到高召回和亚 10 毫秒尾延迟——ANN 的「略损召回」在实践中可以压得很小。它是给检索质量/延迟定目标的参考锚点。
why_en: The >95% recall and sub-10ms p99 are tuned empirical benchmarks (not theoretical limits) showing well-tuned HNSW/FAISS gets both high recall and sub-10ms tail latency, so ANN's recall loss can be made tiny.
options: 说明近似检索必然大幅牺牲召回,95% 已经是极限很差
说明调好的 HNSW/FAISS 能同时拿高召回(>95%)和亚10ms尾延迟,是定检索目标的参考锚点
说明必须用暴力精确检索才能到 95% 召回
说明 p99 延迟和召回无关,可以随意设
options_en: It shows approximate search must sacrifice a lot of recall; 95% is a poor ceiling.
It shows tuned HNSW/FAISS gets both high recall (>95%) and sub-10ms tail latency, a reference anchor for setting retrieval targets.
It shows you must use exact brute-force to reach 95% recall.
It shows p99 latency and recall are unrelated and can be set arbitrarily.

scenario: embedding 模型是按余弦相似度训练的,但索引却配置成用 L2 欧氏距离检索。
scenario_en: The embedding model was trained with cosine similarity, but the index is configured to search with L2 Euclidean distance.
q: 索引的距离度量和模型训练目标不一致,会怎样?
q_en: What happens if the index's distance metric mismatches the model's training objective?
why: 会静默退化检索质量,不报任何错。距离度量(cosine/dot/L2)必须匹配 embedding 模型的训练目标——训练用余弦、检索却用 L2,相似度排序就系统性偏了,结果变差但系统不报错,很难发现。
why_en: It silently degrades retrieval with no error: the index distance metric (cosine/dot/L2) must match the model's training objective, or the similarity ranking is systematically wrong while nothing alarms.
options: 系统会立刻报错,提醒你度量配错了
没影响,任何距离度量结果都一样
会静默退化检索质量、不报错:距离度量必须匹配模型训练目标,不匹配则排序系统性偏了
检索会变得更快更准,度量不匹配是优化技巧
options_en: The system errors out immediately, warning you the metric is misconfigured.
No effect; any distance metric gives the same result.
It silently degrades retrieval with no error: the metric must match the training objective, or ranking is systematically wrong.
Retrieval gets faster and more accurate; a mismatched metric is an optimization trick.
optionExplanations: 度量不匹配不会触发错误,系统照常返回结果,只是结果悄悄变差,这正是它危险的地方。
不同度量给出不同的相似度排序,「结果都一样」与向量几何相悖。
对;训练目标决定该用哪种度量,配错会系统性打乱相似度排序、静默降质,难以察觉。
度量不匹配只会降质,不会更快更准,把它当优化技巧是错误理解。
optionExplanations_en: A metric mismatch triggers no error; the system returns results as usual, just quietly worse — precisely why it's dangerous.
Different metrics give different similarity rankings; 'same result' contradicts vector geometry.
Correct — the training objective dictates the metric, and a mismatch systematically scrambles similarity ranking, silently degrading, hard to detect.
A mismatch only degrades quality, never faster or more accurate; treating it as an optimization trick misunderstands it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量两向量相似/远近的方式(余弦、点积、L2 欧氏),必须与 embedding 训练目标一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distance metric (cosine, dot, L2) measures vector similarity and must match the embedding's training objective.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两向量对应维度差平方和的平方根,一种常见距离度量,与余弦度量在语义上不等价。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: L2 (Euclidean) distance is the root sum of squared per-dimension differences, a common metric not semantically equivalent to cosine.

scenario: 团队更新/微调了 embedding 模型,重新编码了 query,但没有重新编码物品、也没重建 ANN 索引。上线后没报任何错,可 CTR 悄悄往下掉。
scenario_en: The team updated/fine-tuned the embedding model and re-encoded queries but didn't re-encode items or rebuild the ANN index; nothing errors, yet CTR quietly drops.
q: 「陈旧索引(stale index)」问题是怎么发生的,后果是什么?
q_en: How does the 'stale index' problem arise, and what's the consequence?
why: 重训/微调让新模型的向量落在不同的向量空间(embedding drift),旧 ANN 索引就陈旧了:新模型的 query 向量去和旧模型的物品向量比余弦,相似度不可靠,检索质量静默退化——不报错、CTR 却在掉。这是索引层面的训练-服务偏斜。
why_en: Retraining/fine-tuning puts vectors in a different vector space (embedding drift), so new-model query vectors compared against old-model item vectors give unreliable cosine, degrading retrieval silently with no error while CTR drops.
diagram:
flowchart LR U["更新模型
只重编码query"] --> D["embedding drift
向量空间变了"] D --> M["新query向量 vs 旧物品向量"] M --> S["相似度不可靠
静默退化, CTR↓"]
options: 更新模型后系统会立刻报错,检索直接挂掉
新旧向量在不同空间(embedding drift),新query比旧物品向量,相似度不可靠→静默退化、CTR掉、不报错
陈旧索引会让检索变快,是有意优化
只要 query 重编码了就没事,物品向量不用管
options_en: After updating the model the system errors immediately and retrieval breaks.
New and old vectors are in different spaces (embedding drift); new queries vs old item vectors give unreliable similarity → silent degradation, CTR drops, no error.
A stale index makes retrieval faster, a deliberate optimization.
As long as queries are re-encoded it's fine; item vectors don't matter.
optionExplanations: 陈旧索引不报错——这正是它危险之处,系统照常返回结果,质量却悄悄崩。
对;向量空间漂移让新旧向量不可比,余弦排序失真,检索静默退化是这题的核心失败模式。
陈旧索引只会降质不会「有意优化」,把它当优化是完全误读。
只重编码 query 不重编码物品正是制造陈旧索引的原因,物品向量必须同步更新。
optionExplanations_en: A stale index doesn't error — that's the danger; the system returns results as usual while quality quietly collapses.
Correct — vector-space drift makes new and old vectors incomparable, distorting cosine ranking; silent retrieval degradation is the core failure here.
A stale index only degrades quality, not a 'deliberate optimization' — a total misread.
Re-encoding only queries and not items is exactly what creates the stale index; item vectors must be updated together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型更新后未重编码物品/重建的 ANN 索引,新旧向量空间错位导致检索静默退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stale index is an ANN index not re-encoded/rebuilt after a model update, so misaligned vector spaces silently degrade retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型更新使向量空间本身移位,新旧向量不可直接比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding drift is the vector space itself shifting from a model update, making old and new vectors non-comparable.

scenario: 监控报告里同时提到「data drift」和「embedding drift」,面试官问你两者是不是一回事。
scenario_en: A monitoring report mentions both 'data drift' and 'embedding drift', and the interviewer asks if they're the same.
q: embedding drift 和 data drift 有什么区别?
q_en: What's the difference between embedding drift and data drift?
why: 两者不同:data drift 是输入数据分布变了(用户行为/内容变了);embedding drift 是向量空间本身因模型更新而移位——数据没变,但同样的内容被新模型编成了不同向量。前者来自世界变化,后者来自模型变化。
why_en: Data drift is the input distribution changing (user behavior/content shifts), while embedding drift is the vector space itself shifting from a model update, so the same content maps to different vectors even if data is unchanged.
tradeoff: data drift(输入分布变、来自世界) vs embedding drift(向量空间变、来自模型更新)
options: 两者完全一样,只是不同叫法
data drift=输入分布变(来自世界);embedding drift=向量空间因模型更新而移位(内容没变、向量变了)
embedding drift=数据变多、data drift=数据变少
两者都指模型精度下降,没有区别
options_en: They're identical, just different names.
Data drift = input distribution shifts (from the world); embedding drift = vector space shifts from a model update (same content, different vectors).
Embedding drift = more data, data drift = less data.
Both mean accuracy dropping, with no difference.
optionExplanations: 两者起因不同(世界变 vs 模型变),不是同物异名,混为一谈会误诊。
对;data drift 来自输入分布变化,embedding drift 来自模型更新导致向量空间移位,修法也不同。
drift 讲的是分布/空间移位,不是数据量多少,选项理解错了概念。
两者是不同起因的问题,精度下降只是可能症状,不能划等号。
optionExplanations_en: Their causes differ (world vs model change); not the same thing renamed, and conflating them misdiagnoses.
Correct — data drift comes from input distribution shift, embedding drift from a model update shifting the vector space, with different fixes.
Drift is about distribution/space shift, not data volume; the option misreads the concept.
They're different-cause problems; an accuracy drop is only a possible symptom, not an equivalence.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入数据的分布随时间变化(用户行为、内容变了),需重训或更新数据应对。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data drift is the input data distribution changing over time (user behavior, content), addressed by retraining or updating data.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏斜
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练与线上服务时数据/表示不一致导致的退化;陈旧索引是它在索引层的类比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is degradation from data/representation mismatch between training and serving; the stale index is its index-level analog.

scenario: 团队升级了 query 侧的 embedding 模型,但没重新编码物品、也没重建索引,想知道检索会怎样。
scenario_en: The team upgrades the query-side embedding model but doesn't re-encode items or rebuild the index, and wonders what happens to retrieval.
q: 只更新 query 模型、不重编码物品会导致什么?
q_en: Updating only the query model without re-encoding items leads to what?
why: 检索质量静默退化:新 query 向量和旧物品向量落在错位的向量空间里,余弦相似度失去意义,排序变差却不报错。正确做法是 query 和物品必须用同一版本模型编码,或走零停机重建把物品同步更新。
why_en: Retrieval quality silently degrades because new query vectors and old item vectors sit in misaligned embedding spaces, so cosine loses meaning and ranking worsens without error.
tradeoff: 同版本编码query+物品(空间对齐、检索可靠) vs 只更新一侧(空间错位、静默退化)
options: 检索质量静默退化:新query向量与旧物品向量空间错位,余弦失去意义、排序变差却不报错
检索会更准,因为 query 模型更新了更强
系统会自动重编码所有物品,无需人工干预
只影响新物品,老物品检索照常正确
options_en: Retrieval silently degrades: new query vectors and old item vectors are misaligned, cosine loses meaning, ranking worsens with no error.
Retrieval gets more accurate because the query model is newer and stronger.
The system auto-re-encodes all items, no manual intervention needed.
Only new items are affected; old items retrieve correctly as usual.
whenOtherWins: 如果新旧两个模型恰好共享同一向量空间(如仅做了不改变几何的等价变换),query 单侧更新才不致命——但一般微调/重训都会改变空间。
whenOtherWins_en: Only if the new and old models happen to share the same vector space (e.g. a geometry-preserving equivalent transform) is a one-sided query update non-fatal — but fine-tuning/retraining usually shifts the space.
optionExplanations: 对;单侧更新造成空间错位,余弦排序失真,检索静默退化正是这题要点。
query 模型再强,若和物品向量不在同一空间,比出来的相似度也无意义,不会更准。
系统不会自动重编码,物品向量必须显式用新模型重编码才对齐。
错位影响的是所有物品的相似度比较,不只是新物品,老物品同样失真。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — one-sided update misaligns spaces, distorts cosine ranking, and silently degrades retrieval, the point here.
However strong the query model, if it's not in the same space as item vectors, the computed similarity is meaningless, not more accurate.
The system won't auto-re-encode; item vectors must be explicitly re-encoded with the new model to align.
Misalignment affects all items' similarity comparison, not just new ones; old items are distorted too.

termDefinitions.term: misaligned embedding spaces / 向量空间错位
termDefinitions.meaning: query 和物品用不同版本模型编码,向量落在不可比的空间,相似度失真。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Misaligned embedding spaces are query and item vectors encoded by different model versions, landing in non-comparable spaces that distort similarity.

scenario: 要在模型切换期保证零停机,又希望切换那一刻新索引就是完全最新的,不用等回填。
scenario_en: You need zero downtime during a model switch and want the new index fully current the instant you cut over, with no backfill wait.
q: 「双写(dual-write)」重建策略怎么做,代价是什么?
q_en: How does the dual-write rebuild strategy work, and what's its cost?
why: 每个新增/更新的物品同时用新旧两个模型编码,并行写进在线索引和影子索引;等影子索引填满并验证后切流量。好处是切换那刻影子索引已完全最新;代价是过渡期写吞吐和存储翻倍。
why_en: Encode every new/updated item with both old and new models, writing to the live index and a shadow index in parallel, then cut traffic once the shadow is populated and validated, at the cost of temporarily doubled write throughput and storage.
tradeoff: 双写(切换即最新、无回填等待) vs 过渡期写吞吐+存储翻倍
diagram:
flowchart LR
  I["新增/更新物品"] --> O["旧模型→在线索引"]
  I --> N["新模型→影子索引"]
  N --> V["影子填满+验证"]
  V --> S["切流量到影子"]
options: 只用新模型编码,直接覆盖在线索引,不留旧的
每个新增/更新物品用新旧两模型并行写在线+影子索引,填满验证后切;代价是过渡期写吞吐+存储翻倍
先把在线索引删了,再慢慢用新模型重建
只在离线批量重建,完全不碰新增物品
options_en: Encode with the new model only, overwriting the live index directly, keeping nothing old.
Encode every new/updated item with both models, writing live + shadow in parallel; cut over after populate+validate; cost is doubled write throughput+storage during transition.
Delete the live index first, then slowly rebuild with the new model.
Only rebuild offline in batch, never touching newly added items.
whenOtherWins: 如果物品更新非常频繁、写放大代价可接受但离线批量重建窗口太长,双写更合适;若语料基本静止,离线影子重建反而更省。
whenOtherWins_en: If items update very frequently and write amplification is acceptable but an offline batch window is too long, dual-write fits; if the corpus is mostly static, an offline shadow rebuild is cheaper.
optionExplanations: 直接覆盖会在回填期间新旧向量混用、检索错乱,且无回退,不是零停机做法。
对;双写让影子索引始终最新、切换即用,代价是过渡期写吞吐和存储翻倍,取舍清晰。
先删在线索引就直接停服了,违背零停机目标。
只离线重建会漏掉过渡期新增的物品,双写正是为覆盖实时更新而设计。
optionExplanations_en: Direct overwrite mixes old and new vectors during backfill, scrambling retrieval with no rollback — not zero-downtime.
Correct — dual-write keeps the shadow always current for instant cutover, at doubled write throughput and storage during transition, a clear tradeoff.
Deleting the live index first takes the service down, violating zero downtime.
Offline-only rebuild misses items added during transition, which dual-write is designed to cover.

termDefinitions.meaning: 过渡期用新旧两模型同时编码并写入在线与影子索引,保证切换那刻影子已最新。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dual-write encodes with both models and writes to live and shadow indexes during transition, keeping the shadow current at cutover.

termDefinitions.meaning: 与在线索引并存的后台索引,填充/验证好后再原子切换承接流量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shadow index is a background index alongside the live one, atomically swapped in to take traffic once populated and validated.

scenario: 语料基本静态,重建 1 亿+物品的索引要几个小时,你想让在线服务完全不受影响。
scenario_en: The corpus is mostly static, rebuilding a 100M+ item index takes hours, and you want the live service completely undisturbed.
q: 「影子索引(shadow index)」重建策略适合什么场景,怎么切换?
q_en: When does the shadow-index rebuild strategy fit, and how do you switch?
why: 在批处理基础设施上后台做整份离线重建,在线索引照常服务不受打扰;用离线召回基准或 A/B 影子打分(线上 query 同时打到新旧索引比对)验证后,再原子切换。代价是需要额外离线算力,但服务路径零影响。
why_en: Do a full offline rebuild in the background on batch infra while the live index serves undisturbed, validate via offline recall benchmarks or A/B shadow scoring, then atomically swap, at the cost of extra offline compute but zero serving-path impact.
tradeoff: 影子索引(服务零影响、离线验证后切) vs 需额外离线算力做整份重建
options: 在在线索引上原地慢慢改,边服务边重建
直接把新索引推上线,不做任何验证
后台离线整份重建,在线索引照常服务;离线基准/A-B影子打分验证后原子切换;代价是额外离线算力
让用户暂停使用几小时等重建完成
options_en: Modify the live index in place slowly, rebuilding while serving.
Push the new index live directly with no validation.
Full offline rebuild in the background while the live index serves; validate via offline benchmarks/A-B shadow scoring, then atomically swap; cost is extra offline compute.
Have users pause for hours while the rebuild finishes.
whenOtherWins: 如果物品更新极其频繁,离线重建刚做完就又过期了,双写(实时并行写两索引)比一次性影子重建更合适。
whenOtherWins_en: If items update extremely frequently so an offline rebuild is stale the moment it finishes, dual-write (real-time parallel writes) fits better than a one-shot shadow rebuild.
optionExplanations: 在线原地改会让服务在重建期读到半新半旧的索引,检索错乱,违背零影响目标。
不验证直接推上线可能把退化的索引换上去,失去了影子索引先验证的意义。
对;离线后台重建+验证+原子切换,服务路径零影响,是静态语料大重建的标准做法。
让用户暂停几小时不是零停机,影子索引正是为避免停服而设计。
optionExplanations_en: In-place live edits make the service read a half-new/half-old index during rebuild, scrambling retrieval and violating zero impact.
Pushing live without validation may swap in a degraded index, defeating the point of validating the shadow first.
Correct — offline background rebuild + validation + atomic swap keeps the serving path untouched, the standard for large static-corpus rebuilds.
Pausing users for hours isn't zero downtime; the shadow index exists precisely to avoid an outage.

termDefinitions.term: A/B shadow scoring / A-B 影子打分
termDefinitions.meaning: 把线上真实 query 同时打到新旧索引,离线对比结果质量,以此验证新索引再切换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A/B shadow scoring sends live queries to both old and new indexes and compares results offline to validate the new one before switching.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一瞬间把服务从旧索引切到新索引,不出现半新半旧的中间态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic swap flips serving from old to new index instantly, with no half-new/half-old intermediate state.

scenario: 索引已经分片(sharded)到很大规模,一次性重建全部风险太高,想把每次变更的影响面限制在一个分片内。
scenario_en: The index is sharded at very large scale, a full one-shot rebuild is too risky, and you want each change's blast radius limited to a single shard.
q: 「滚动切换(rolling swap)」策略解决什么,代价是什么?
q_en: What does the rolling-swap strategy solve, and what's its cost?
why: 针对分片索引,逐个分片重建+切换,把爆炸半径限制在单个分片,超大规模下最小化风险。代价是运维复杂:过渡期查询会跨越新旧版本混合的分片,要处理版本混用的一致性。
why_en: For sharded indexes, rebuild and swap shards one at a time to limit the blast radius to a single shard, minimizing risk at very large scale, at the cost of operational complexity since queries span mixed-version shards during transition.
tradeoff: 滚动切换(爆炸半径限于单分片、超大规模最稳) vs 运维复杂(过渡期跨新旧版本分片)
options: 把所有分片一次性同时重建,速度最快
分片索引逐个重建+切换,爆炸半径限于单分片、超大规模最稳;代价是过渡期查询跨新旧版本分片、运维复杂
只重建第一个分片,其它永远不动
把分片全部合并成一个大索引再重建
options_en: Rebuild all shards at once simultaneously for maximum speed.
Rebuild+swap sharded index shard by shard, blast radius limited to one shard, safest at huge scale; cost is queries spanning mixed-version shards during transition, operationally complex.
Rebuild only the first shard and never touch the others.
Merge all shards into one big index, then rebuild.
whenOtherWins: 如果规模没大到需要分片,或能接受整份离线重建的窗口,影子索引更简单,不必承担滚动切换的版本混用复杂度。
whenOtherWins_en: If scale doesn't require sharding, or a full offline rebuild window is acceptable, a shadow index is simpler and avoids rolling-swap's mixed-version complexity.
optionExplanations: 一次性全重建把爆炸半径放到最大,一旦出问题全线受影响,与限制风险的目标相反。
对;逐分片重建切换把风险锁在单分片,代价是过渡期版本混用带来的运维复杂度。
只重建一个分片会让其余分片永久陈旧,检索长期不一致,不是完整策略。
把分片合并成单索引丢掉了分片的隔离优势,重建风险反而更大。
optionExplanations_en: A simultaneous full rebuild maximizes blast radius, so any failure hits everything, opposite to limiting risk.
Correct — shard-by-shard rebuild/swap locks risk into one shard, at the cost of mixed-version operational complexity during transition.
Rebuilding only one shard leaves the rest permanently stale, causing long-term inconsistency — not a complete strategy.
Merging shards into a single index loses the isolation benefit of sharding, raising rebuild risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分片索引逐个重建并切换,把每次变更的风险限制在单个分片内。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rolling swap rebuilds and swaps a sharded index shard by shard, confining each change's risk to a single shard.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次变更/故障能波及的范围;分片+滚动切换把它限制在单个分片。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blast radius is how far a change/failure can spread; sharding plus rolling swap confines it to one shard.

scenario: 用影子索引策略做一次零停机的 embedding 索引重建。
scenario_en: Perform a zero-downtime embedding index rebuild using the shadow-index strategy.
q: 把影子索引零停机重建的步骤排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the zero-downtime shadow-index rebuild steps correctly:
steps: 用新模型在批处理基础设施上后台整份重建影子索引
在线旧索引继续照常服务、不受打扰
原子切换:流量切到影子索引,旧索引退役
离线召回基准 / A-B 影子打分验证影子索引质量
why: 步骤:在线旧索引继续服务 → 后台用新模型整份离线重建影子索引 → 用离线基准/A-B影子打分验证 → 验证通过后原子切换、旧索引退役。全程服务路径零影响,验证在切换前完成才敢切。
why_en: Keep the live old index serving, rebuild the shadow offline with the new model, validate via offline benchmark/A-B shadow scoring, then atomically swap — validation before cutover so the switch is safe.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["旧索引继续服务"] --> B["后台重建影子索引"]
  B --> C["验证: 基准/A-B打分"]
  C --> D["原子切换, 旧索引退役"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 重建索引期间在线服务不中断,靠影子/双写/滚动切换在后台完成再切换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A zero-downtime rebuild keeps serving uninterrupted while rebuilding in the background via shadow/dual-write/rolling swap before switching.

scenario: 在模型切换过渡期,同一个物品可能既有旧模型向量、又有新模型向量,服务要能取到对的那个。
scenario_en: During a model-switch transition, one item may have both old and new vectors, and serving must fetch the right one.
q: feature store 的 embedding 版本管理怎么支撑零停机重建?
q_en: How does feature-store embedding versioning support zero-downtime rebuilds?
why: 对每个实体同时保留新旧两个版本的 embedding,服务在过渡期按当前该用哪个版本路由到正确的向量,避免新旧混用造成的陈旧索引问题。它是双写/影子/滚动三种策略共同的底座。
why_en: Keep both old and new embeddings per entity so serving routes to the correct version during transitions, preventing the stale-index problem of mixing versions, underpinning all three rebuild strategies.
options: 对每个实体同时保留新旧版本 embedding,过渡期路由到正确版本,避免新旧混用的陈旧索引问题
只保留最新版本,旧向量立刻删掉省空间
把所有版本混在一起,让服务随机取一个
版本管理只用于训练,和线上服务无关
options_en: Keep both old and new embeddings per entity, routing to the correct version during transition, avoiding the stale-index problem of mixing versions.
Keep only the latest version and delete old vectors immediately to save space.
Mix all versions together and let serving pick one at random.
Versioning is only for training, unrelated to online serving.
optionExplanations: 对;每实体存新旧两版、按当前策略路由到正确版本,是三种重建策略共用的底座。
过渡期立刻删旧向量,会让还没切换的服务取不到匹配版本,反而制造错位。
随机取版本正是制造新旧空间错位、陈旧索引的根源,与版本管理的目的相反。
版本管理恰恰在线上服务的过渡期发挥路由作用,不只是训练侧概念。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — storing both versions per entity and routing to the right one underpins all three rebuild strategies.
Deleting old vectors immediately during transition leaves not-yet-switched serving unable to find a matching version, causing misalignment.
Picking a version at random is exactly what creates space misalignment and a stale index, opposite to versioning's purpose.
Versioning serves a routing role precisely during the online-serving transition, not only a training-side concept.

termDefinitions.term: feature-store embedding versioning / 特征库嵌入版本管理
termDefinitions.meaning: 在特征库里对每个实体保留新旧多版本向量,服务按需路由到正确版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feature-store embedding versioning keeps multiple vector versions per entity so serving routes to the correct one on demand.

scenario: 两个候选人都会讲怎么选 embedding 模型,但只有一个主动提了陈旧索引和具体重建策略。
scenario_en: Two candidates can both discuss choosing an embedding model, but only one proactively raises the stale index and a concrete rebuild strategy.
q: 在 embedding 题里,什么最能体现 L5+ 的运维成熟度?
q_en: In an embeddings question, what best signals L5+ operational maturity?
why: 主动提出陈旧索引这个核心失败模式,并给一个具体的重建策略(如影子索引+离线验证),用规模/延迟论证为什么选它。泛泛说「用 ANN 检索」缺运维深度;把模型更新连到索引管理与零停机重建,才是资深区分点。
why_en: Proactively raising the stale index as the central failure mode and proposing a specific rebuild strategy justified by scale/latency, since connecting a model update to index management and zero-downtime rebuild separates senior from prototype.
options: 背出最多 embedding 模型的名字
把向量维度调到最大
主动提陈旧索引这个核心失败模式 + 给一个按规模/延迟论证的具体重建策略
只讨论选哪个模型最准,不谈更新后的运维
options_en: Reciting the most embedding model names.
Maxing out the vector dimension.
Proactively raising the stale index as the central failure mode + a specific rebuild strategy justified by scale/latency.
Only debating which model is most accurate, not the post-update operations.
optionExplanations: 背名字是记忆,不体现你懂 embedding 在生产里的生命周期与失败模式。
调大维度是无根据的旋钮乱动,与运维成熟度无关。
对;把更新连到陈旧索引+具体零停机重建策略,并用规模/延迟论证,正是 L5+ 的运维深度。
只谈选模型不谈更新后的索引运维,恰恰是原型级而非生产级的短板。
optionExplanations_en: Reciting names is memory and doesn't show you grasp the embedding production lifecycle and failure modes.
Maxing dimension is baseless knob-twiddling, unrelated to operational maturity.
Correct — connecting updates to the stale index plus a concrete zero-downtime strategy justified by scale/latency is exactly L5+ ops depth.
Discussing only model choice without post-update index ops is precisely the prototype-level, not production-level, gap.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在设计里主动考虑上线后的失败模式与恢复(陈旧索引、零停机重建),是资深级别的区分信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Operational maturity is proactively designing for post-launch failure modes and recovery (stale index, zero-downtime rebuild), a senior-level signal.
